explanation: Mathlib has the converse direction, `Scheme.Modules.exists_isOpenCover_presentation` in AlgebraicGeometry/Modules/Tilde.lean: a quasi-coherent module has presentations on the restrictions to the pieces of some open cover. I found nothing going the other way, from presentations of `M.restrict (U i).ι` back to `M.IsQuasicoherent`. The general lemma `SheafOfModules.IsQuasicoherent.of_coversTop` (Algebra/Category/ModuleCat/Sheaf/Quasicoherent.lean) needs quasi-coherence of `M.over (X i)`, not presentations of restrictions. Bridging the two needs the library's own `presentationOverOfPresentationRestrict`, which turns a presentation of the restriction into one over the open. Rebuilding that step from Mathlib's pieces (`overFunctorEquiv`, `Presentation.map`, `restrictUnitIso`) is not a short derivation. Searched: every IsQuasicoherent/isQuasicoherent declaration in Mathlib (three files: Tilde.lean, Sheaf/Quasicoherent.lean, Sheaf/LocallyFree.lean), plus Presentation, QuasicoherentData and of_coversTop lemmas under AlgebraicGeometry.
